items.label: Help above the prompt
items.help: Show the command's options above the prompt while you type: Help is a read-only panel, Options a list you can pick from. Off keeps the palette clean.

items.label: Default commands
items.help: A bare command word runs a line you choose (phase 1b: core sends no link rows yet).

items.label: Mapping on
items.help: Run the MIDI bindings. Off drops every incoming message (the same as map --off).

items.label: Fold after
items.help: Tags with more tracks than this start folded on the board.
